name: Cozy Bear
description: Cozy Bear (APT29) is a Russian SVR (foreign intelligence) cyber espionage group that penetrated the DNC in 2015 (alongside Fancy Bear), the US State Department, the 2020 SolarWinds supply chain attack affecting 18,000+ organizations, and Microsoft executive email accounts in 2024. Dutch intelligence AIVD monitored the group since 2014 and provided evidence to US investigators.
